workflows.scenario: Start a bank simulator session, confirm the dashboard is usable, and view the checking account activity as a read-only journey

steps.action: Open the public bank simulator home page
steps.expected: The welcome page displays the Get Started button
The dashboard loads and shows the first-run welcome dialog
The dashboard displays the checking account activity card with an available balance

steps.action: Open the checking account activity from the dashboard
steps.expected: The browser navigates to the account activity page for the checking account

steps.action: Verify the checking account transaction history
steps.expected: The account activity page shows the checking account selected and lists the transaction history including the account opening entry
